2609.26603.title: Towards Hierarchical GNNs for multi-grid power flow: generalization across operating scenarios
2609.26603.paper_summary: Hierarchical latent communication improves the generalization of a multi-grid power-flow model to new operating scenarios. The module exchanges information through two reduced graphs within a GENCO-based corrective network. We compare Kron-derived transports, a same-anchor Quotient construction and a flat backbone in preliminary trainings of 200 epochs on three grid topologies, with three initialization seeds per model. Evaluation uses 200 newly generated, preselected scenarios per grid. On the training topologies, Kron reduces the macro family-balanced voltage error from 5.660 +- 0.899 to 0.851 +- 0.110: an 85.0% reduction relative to Flat GENCO and 31.0% relative to Quotient, which reaches 1.235 +- 0.225. Both hierarchical models outperform a per-bus mean fitted on training solutions on every training topology in all three seeds. These results demonstrate generalization across operating scenarios within the studied topologies, with one set of learned parameters shared across grids. Evaluation on two additional topologies distinguishes this achievement from cross-topology generalization: the current models do not yet outperform the fitted reference in that calibrated- transfer setting. This preprint presents the architecture and preliminary evidence for hierarchical communication as a component of multi-grid power-flow learning, with generalization to unseen topologies as the next development objective.
2609.26603.paper_summary_zh: 階層式潛在通訊改善了多網格功率流模型對新操作場景的泛化能力。該模組通過兩個減少的圖形在基於GENCO的修正網絡中交換信息。我們比較了Kron衍生的傳輸、相同錨點的商構建以及在三個網格拓撲的初步訓練中進行的平坦骨幹，並對每個模型使用三個初始化種子進行200個時期的訓練。評估使用每個網格200個新生成的預選場景。在訓練拓撲上，Kron將宏觀家庭平衡電壓誤差從5.660 ± 0.899降低到0.851 ± 0.110：相對於平坦GENCO減少了85.0%，相對於商構建減少了31.0%，後者達到1.235 ± 0.225。這兩個階層模型在所有三個種子中，在每個訓練拓撲上均超越了基於訓練解的每總線均值擬合。這些結果顯示了在研究的拓撲內跨操作場景的泛化，並且一組學習的參數在各個網格間共享。在兩個額外拓撲上的評估將這一成就與跨拓撲泛化區分開來：目前的模型在該校準轉移設置中尚未超越擬合參考。這篇預印本展示了階層通訊的架構和初步證據，作為多網格功率流學習的一個組件，未來的發展目標是實現對未見拓撲的泛化。
